title: HE IS ABLE TO KEEP YOU
A BEDTIME PRAYER FOR REST
end: The Secret Place — prayers every day
stock_queries: misty calm lake night silent water
dark pine forest under starry night sky
soft glowing lantern on dark wooden deck
calm ocean waves at dusk blue hour
night sky full of bright stars over mountains
gentle river flowing through quiet night forest
calm moonlit mountain lake still water

scenes.a: Your mind is racing in the dark tonight.
You worry you will stumble tomorrow under the weight you carry.
Quiet your heart and hear these words.
Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy,
To the only wise God our Savior, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen.
Lord, hold us steady when our legs feel weak. Keep our hearts from falling into fear tonight, and rest us safe in your strong hands.
Amen. Your mind is racing in the dark.
